2610.11031.title: Language Modeling is Monotone Compression
2610.11031.paper_summary:
A long-standing hypothesis in artificial intelligence and neuroscience posits that intelligence is closely related to compression: the ability to compress information efficiently intuitively reflects capacities associated with intelligence and learning. Indeed, recent experimental works verify this intuition by showing connections between the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and their ability as compressors: for instance, Deletang et al. (ICLR'24) demonstrate that LLMs can be used as powerful compressors, and Huang et al. (COLM'24) show that the compression ability of LLMs is highly correlated with their performance on benchmarks for knowledge and reasoning.
  In this work, we initiate a theoretical study of this connection. Our main result is that LLMs (formally modeled as next-token predictors) are equivalent to monotone (a.k.a. order-preserving) compression algorithms---namely, compression algorithms where the encoding process preserves the ordering of the inputs---in the sense that the one can be constructed from the other while preserving the same error up to an additive gap of 2.
  We next show that the monotonicity is required for this equivalence to hold if and only if cryptographic (infinitely-often) one-way functions exist.
  As a direct corollary, we get a cryptographic result of independent interest: the notion of next-bit pseudoentropy (a computational analogue of entropy) of a distribution is equivalent to monotone incompressibility of the distribution. (Previously, it was only known (Haitner et al., ITCS'23) that incompressibility implies next-bit pseudoentropy.)
2610.11031.paper_summary_zh: 一個長期存在的假設在人工智慧和神經科學中認為，智慧與壓縮密切相關：有效壓縮信息的能力直觀地反映了與智慧和學習相關的能力。事實上，最近的實驗工作通過顯示大型語言模型（LLMs）的能力與其作為壓縮器的能力之間的聯繫來驗證這一直覺：例如，Deletang 等人（ICLR'24）證明 LLMs 可以用作強大的壓縮器，而 Huang 等人（COLM'24）則顯示 LLMs 的壓縮能力與其在知識和推理基準測試上的表現高度相關。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們開始對這一聯繫進行理論研究。我們的主要結果是 LLMs（正式建模為下一個標記預測器）等同於單調（即保序）壓縮算法——即編碼過程保持輸入的順序的壓縮算法——在這個意義上，可以從另一個構建出來，同時保持相同的錯誤，最多有 2 的加性差距。<lb/>接下來，我們顯示單調性是這一等價性成立的必要條件，當且僅當存在密碼學（無限次）單向函數。<lb/>作為直接的推論，我們得到了一個獨立的密碼學結果：分佈的下一位偽熵（熵的計算類比）的概念等同於該分佈的單調不可壓縮性。（之前，只知道（Haitner 等人，ITCS'23）不可壓縮性意味著下一位偽熵。）
